study_card.difficulty: 项目协作 · 词汇主线
study_card.main_practice: 先听故事 · 再跟读 · 最后替换成自己的经历
value_points: 当天 18 个词汇都进入 Alex 的故事
库、依赖与框架 × 表达偏好和选择 × 变更日志
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 听读 2 遍 · 遮住中文复述 · 完成输出任务

segments.en: By day 20, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "library" and "dependency" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "I prefer the first option." and "I'd rather wait." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "changelog" and "breaking change" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.

segments.en: By day 20, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "package manager" and "dependency version" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "It depends on the situation." and "Let's choose this one." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "deprecation notice" and "release summary" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.
